name: Oni Subdomain
body:
Oni are a race of evil native outsiders.

Associated Domain(s): Evil.

Replacement Power: The following power replaces the scythe of evil power of the Evil domain.

Hedonism (Su)

At 8th level, your harmful magic arouses pleasurable feelings in the victim, making it wish for more.

When you cast a spell that deals damage and targets one creature only, you can choose to modify it as with the Dazing Spell feat (even if you don’t possess this feat), without increasing the spell’s level. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every 4 levels beyond 8th.

Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—alter self, 3rd—ja noi aspect, 7th—regenerate.
